"Still on their secret."

"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."

"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
"Don't tell anyone I told you. What's on your mind? Think, then act."
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Violet is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"The free things. Turns out they were the expensive ones."

"an old trapline — I'll show you on the map sometime. It's real."

"Finally. I was wondering when you'd see my value."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want? Seen worse."

"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
